critical_code_review_comments: PmHaulActivityTile.jsx (244 lines) — clean, single-purpose, well under the 700-line ceiling. Read-only by design: zero buttons, zero hrefs, zero write affordances inside the tile (verified empirically — DOM scan returned empty interactive set). Poll cadence honors doctrine (POLL_MS=60000, not 5s). Calm-tone Stat helper correctly maps tones: calm=text-slate-400 / active=text-slate-900 / warn=text-amber-700 / danger=text-rose-700.
Tile uses fetch w/ silent catch — failures degrade to empty tile rather than crashing PmHub; appropriate for a non-critical awareness tile.
buildHeaders() attaches all portal tokens permissively (admin/dispatch/pm/shop/safety/hr/fl) — fine for read-only GET; backend auth gate is what enforces tenancy/scope.

Backend GET /api/dispatch/haul-activity correctly derives from existing dispatch_assignments + haul_cycles — no new collection, no new write surface (doctrine preserved). _materialize_haul_cycle now additively populates haul_type/equipment_label/pickup_location/dropoff_location; no regression on prior cycle consumers (iter408/iter407/iter396 parity still 100%).
Project-scope query supports both ?project_number=X (single) and ?project_numbers=A,B (multi) — symmetric with iter408 lookup endpoints.
